graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each assessed input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Optional missing inputs use estimation context only (the gap is noted in the conditioning context) with no hard evidence, so no update occurs on an unobserved node. Owner to accept or restrict any mapping to observation-only.

graph_decision.why_this_shape: All seven BN-12 review outputs are preserved as network nodes with their BN-12 parent structure (indication over severity/association; regimen over indication plus feasibilities and tradeoff; safety over the three anticholinergic contexts; symptomatic over indication, TD concern, and preference; continuation over current use and severity; amantadine over indication and safety; prophylaxis over severity and prior history), restructured into a 20-node executable network with explicit unknown states and one required input. No latent nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions. TABLE-10 product/dose content, regimen numbers, and the BN-12 inference/deployment flags were not copied.

question_enumeration.applicability: Follow-up encounters only (encounter.kind == followup) with parkinsonism effect status present. Absent yields not_applicable with reason; not_assessed/missing/conflicting yields needs_clarification stopping later questions.
question_enumeration.intended_setting: Adult outpatient follow-up for schizophrenia; current dated encounter. Not the emergency department, except that severe/urgent features trigger immediate emergency evaluation per local protocol. Local setting confirmation requested.

output_meanings.address_current_assessment: Parallel prompt: parkinsonism is currently present, so prophylaxis is moot; address the current assessment. Prior history never authorizes prophylaxis.
output_meanings.assess_differential_and_association: Review prompt: attribution is alternative-or-unresolved or still unknown; assess onset, medication-change linkage, and alternatives before any symptomatic-medication discussion. No option prompt from this branch.
output_meanings.discuss_anticholinergic_option: Review prompt: established association without TD concern and without preference concern; discuss a short-term or longer-term anticholinergic option with safety review per current local labeling. Not a prescription.
output_meanings.discuss_patient_concerns: Review prompt: established association with a recorded preference concern or preserved uncertainty; discuss what bothers the patient and what the tradeoffs are. Not a prescription.
output_meanings.established_current_association: Review prompt: parkinsonism associated with antipsychotic therapy is recorded; discuss feasible dose reduction, feasible switch, or symptomatic medication with tradeoff monitoring. Not a prescription and not a product/dose choice.
output_meanings.no_current_treatment_rule: Retained vocabulary state only; never dominant under the present gate. Absence is gated, never a posterior.
output_meanings.review_lowest_dose_and_duration: Parallel prompt: existing anticholinergic use prompts review of need, lowest effective dose, and shortest necessary duration; reassessment never mandates abrupt withdrawal.

question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current encounter (no outcome prediction horizon). Recovery after medication change can be delayed over weeks to months; persistence warrants reassessment as a parallel review note, not a timed prediction.
question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult follow-up encounter whose parkinsonism effect status is recorded as present, given current functional/urgent severity, attribution context, dose/switch feasibility, psychosis tradeoff, patient preference, anticholinergic safety context, current anticholinergic use, prior significant parkinsonism, amantadine safety, and TD concern, what is the posterior distribution over indication review prompts (established association vs assess differential vs no rule), with parallel regimen, safety, symptomatic-medication, continuation, amantadine, and prophylaxis review prompts, to structure physician review?

reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline evidence rating (2C) or SAS value/threshold was converted into a probability.
reference_table_provenance.rule: Root references illustrative (Severity [0.60,0.30,0.10]; Attribution [0.55,0.25,0.20]; Dose [0.40,0.40,0.20]; Switch [0.35,0.45,0.20]; Psychosis [0.30,0.50,0.20]; Preference [0.45,0.40,0.15]; Safety [0.25,0.55,0.20]; Older [0.30,0.55,0.15]; Burden [0.30,0.50,0.20]; CurrentUse [0.20,0.65,0.15]; Prior [0.25,0.60,0.15]; AmantadineSafety [0.20,0.60,0.20]; TD [0.15,0.70,0.15]). Indication rows from the documented mapping: associated -> established [0.82,0.09,0.09] (3 rows); alternative/unknown -> assess [0.09,0.82,0.09] (6 rows). Regimen rows: non-established indication -> establish [0.80 dominant, 0.04 x5] (54 rows); established with tradeoff present/unknown -> prioritize (18 rows); established with tradeoff absent -> dose/switch/both/constraints by feasibility (9 rows). Safety: any present/unknown -> enhanced [0.88,0.12] (26 rows); only all-absent -> routine [0.12,0.88] (1 row). Symptomatic: non-established -> establish [0.06 x3, 0.82] (18 rows); established with TD present/unknown -> tardive differential (6 rows); established with TD absent and preference present/unknown -> concerns (2 rows); established with TD absent and preference absent -> anticholinergic option (1 row). Continuation: use yes -> lowest [0.82,0.09,0.09] (3 rows); use no -> no-rule (3 rows); use unknown -> reassess (3 rows). Amantadine: non-established -> establish (6 rows); established with safety absent -> discuss alternative (1 row); established with safety present/unknown -> review concerns (2 rows). Prophylaxis: every row under the present gate -> address_current [0.09,0.09,0.82] (9 rows). Lookup exists only to give the validator/inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.

source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-12 is an incomplete, inference-disabled and deployment-disabled drafting lead, not an approved mapping. Its 13 missing root distributions were replaced with synthetic references and its seven deterministic 0/1 tables with soft argmax-preserving placeholders; no BN-12 activation metadata was copied.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed graph, states, transforms, horizons, wording, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.
source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical threshold or converting evidence grades into probabilities.

source_comparison.bn12_cdss_restriction: BN-12 PROPERTY guideline_cdss_restriction and STATEMENT-12 Quality Measurement Considerations state this suggestion is not appropriate for electronic decision support or quality measurement. The restriction is quoted verbatim in network.xml and template.json, carried as owner question Q7, and resolved in v0.1 by offering research review prompts only with no automatic prescribing, dosing, discontinuation, prophylaxis, efficacy ranking, or treatment-response prediction. Owner to confirm this resolution or block activation.
source_comparison.bn12_scope_vs_f3: BN-12 is a 20-node review-workflow draft (13 clinician inputs + 7 deterministic review outputs) with inference_allowed=false and deployment_allowed=false. F3 keeps its input vocabulary and all seven parallel review outputs with their BN-12 parent structure, restructured into a 20-node executable network (13 roots with explicit unknown states + 7 outputs, 18 GIVEN edges, 795 cells). All seven BN-12 deterministic 0/1 tables were replaced with soft argmax-preserving synthetic placeholders; no BN-12 TABLE bytes, priors, or inference/deployment flags were copied.
source_comparison.criteria_reuse: Onset within weeks of initiation/escalation (later onset occurs), pre-exposure symptom review, exclusions (Parkinson disease, other neurology, catatonia, negative symptoms, depressive slowing, unmasking), delayed recovery with reassessment, selected DAT imaging, falls/functional-limitation documentation, and the NMS urgent paragraph are background for the proposed AttributionContext field and the severity/urgent-flag design; none is encoded as a network gate or probability. SAS 10-item 0-4 anchors, raw 0-40 total, mean 0-4, the 0.3 normal-range convention, and the 0.65/0.7 screening proposal are background measurement knowledge only.
source_comparison.guideline_gives_no_threshold: STATEMENT-12 states a 2C suggestion for dose lowering, switching, or anticholinergic treatment, with amantadine as an alternative, lowest-dose/shortest-duration continuation, and occasional individualized prophylaxis in high-risk patients (other guidelines differ). No severity threshold, product/dose selection, or prophylaxis authorization rule is encoded; the seven outputs preserve that wording as review prompts only, and the posterior maximum is never a prescription rule.
source_comparison.history_reuse: FR-21 status/severity mechanics are reused as the gate plus ParkinsonismSeverity mapping; the three functional/urgent severity categories follow the history-effects draft proposal (itself awaiting_review and therefore unapproved). The history draft mapping gaps (unresolved-vs-not_assessed, effect-specific inputs) are resolved here by the separate AttributionContext and twelve further proposed fields, each unknown-permitting except the required severity.
source_comparison.sas_bands_forbidden: The criteria source states the original SAS does not define validated mild, moderate, and severe total-score bands and warns against assigning such labels from locally reproduced cutoffs. F3 therefore has no mild/moderate/severe node and maps no SAS total, mean, or threshold; severity is the functional/urgent enum only, and SAS remains measurement-only per the manifest, prompt, template, and examples.
